_comment: Security-sensitive curated project and go-to-market configuration for the SemiSkill command centre. Live signals (git, DB, tests, inbox) are merged by dashboard/server.py. Changes require the normal reviewed repository workflow plus an updated adjacent integrity pin; prompt text becomes separate-worker input.

project.name: SemiSkill
project.one_liner: No skill becomes discoverable until it passes a six-stage security pipeline and a human approval gate. The catalog is written only by the approval actuator — never by a submitter.

layers.name: Capture / Sourcing
layers.role: Ingest submissions, comments, ratings, reuse → raw captured artifacts

layers.name: Spine + Artifacts
layers.role: Append-only store + five-class event spine + derived lifecycle

layers.name: Context
layers.role: ACL-enforced catalog search / lineage / reuse (+ read API)

layers.name: Intelligence
layers.role: Stability gate + queue ranking + model routing

pipeline_stages.name: Static structure
pipeline_stages.detail: Frontmatter/tool-declaration/structure checks; dangerous-tool + executable-payload hard-fails. This source reference is not current-run evidence.

pipeline_stages.name: Security audit
pipeline_stages.coverage_contract: configured for every submission; explicit not_run when absent
pipeline_stages.detail: Uses an injected, pinned runner. Production still needs an egress-controlled adapter; absence emits visible not_run evidence.

pipeline_stages.name: Held-out injection corpus
pipeline_stages.detail: Corpus isolation source is present; a current source-bound run is required for execution credit.

pipeline_stages.name: Secret / PII
pipeline_stages.detail: Credential-shape, internal-URL and PII scanner source is present; this is not current-run evidence.

pipeline_stages.name: Calibrated LLM judge
pipeline_stages.coverage_contract: sampled by policy; explicit not_sampled when absent
pipeline_stages.detail: Calibration and drift controls exist; production still needs an approved live judge adapter and credentials.

pipeline_stages.name: Aggregate verdict
pipeline_stages.coverage_contract: emitted for every completed pipeline run
pipeline_stages.detail: Source contract retains the full scan chain. Any hard-fail forces reject; current execution requires bound run evidence.

gtm.positioning_hypothesis: For engineering organisations that restrict Agent Skills because an unsafe skill can become a data-exfiltration vector, SemiSkill proposes an internal marketplace where verification is a precondition of publishing. This positioning is unvalidated and makes no adoption or customer claim.

icp.entry_experiment: Invite one approved DV guild to a measured pilot after the release gate passes.

icp.rationale_hypothesis: Software, firmware, data and IT may share the same policy blocker, but no demand evidence is available.
icp.entry_experiment: Interview adjacent functions only after the DV-84 release is complete.

icp.rationale_hypothesis: Regulated organisations may value the governance model; no customer or willingness-to-pay evidence exists.
icp.entry_experiment: No outreach in this phase; require a separately approved commercialization discovery plan.

actions.label: Build the approver console
actions.prompt: Build the approver console over the review queue so a resolver-authenticated human can approve or reject an exact skill version through governance.publish.decide_publication. Bind the decision to the expected payload hash, automated review, independent content review, registry facets and authentication context; only the verified projection actuator may publish. Never write the catalog directly. Write the failing test first.

actions.label: Author scan-report view
actions.prompt: Give submitters a view of their own skill's scan report (per-stage findings + verdict + how to fix) via the read API, ACL-scoped so an author sees only their own submissions.

actions.label: Configure production Entra binding
actions.prompt: Configure the approved Entra issuer, tenant and resolver credentials for the existing verified bearer/group binding, then prove production fails closed for forged, missing and wrong-tenant claims.

actions.label: Comment / rating / reuse write path
actions.prompt: Add the write path for comments, ratings, and reuse events: API endpoints + tests, artifacts appended with correct provenance and permission labels. No catalog writes.

actions.label: Notifications on verdict + publish
actions.prompt: Add a notification hook so a submitter learns their verdict and a publish is announced. Keep it pluggable (no vendor lock) and test with a fake transport.

actions.label: After 84: plan taxonomy expansion
actions.prompt: Only after the current 84 DV skills are independently reviewed, explicitly approved and published, propose a separately gated plan for additional functions. Do not expand the current release scope.

actions.label: Build + serve the catalog UI
actions.prompt: Get ui/ actually building and served against the read API (npm install, build, run), replacing the static demo. Report anything that blocks.

actions.label: Live stage-2 security audit
actions.prompt: Wire the stage-2 security-audit scanner to a real runner inside an egress-controlled sandbox, and prove it runs on a submission end-to-end.

actions.label: Live stage-5 judge + recalibrate
actions.prompt: Wire a live Claude judge for stage 5, re-run the κ calibration against the held-out corpus, and report drift + agreement vs the FakeJudge baseline.

actions.label: Fresh red-team wave
actions.prompt: Use a frozen corpus with immutable hashes and run it against the exact current source and isolated test database. Fixture rows are inputs, not a result. Persist the complete source-bound execution artifact before reporting an escape; if execution is unavailable, report unavailable and do not mutate the frozen corpus from the same run.

actions.label: Threat model + diagram
actions.prompt: Write the threat model for SemiSkill (assets, actors, trust boundaries, attacks, controls) with a diagram, and fold it into docs/SECURITY.md.

actions.label: Set up CI
actions.prompt: Add CI that runs the full suite against an isolated test database on every push. A badge may be derived only from a persisted result bound to the exact current tree, commit, test database identity and complete count conservation; otherwise show unavailable.

actions.label: Pick a deploy target + runbook
actions.prompt: Propose two deployment options for the artifact store + pipeline + read API given egress control, recommend one as an ADR, and write the runbook.

actions.label: Backup / restore policy
actions.prompt: Design and implement backup + restore for the append-only artifact store, including a restore drill with verification.

actions.label: Instrument the funnel
actions.prompt: Instrument separate cohorts: unique people for awareness, browse, first reuse and habit; skill versions for submission and verified publication. Define identity, UTC windows, deduplication, ACL scope and corrections before collection. Do not infer historical backfill or grant instrumentation credit from curated targets.

actions.label: Write the launch blog post
actions.prompt: Draft the launch blog post using only source-bound current evidence. If red-team, publication, adoption or customer results are unavailable, say unavailable and leave placeholders rather than inventing proof. Save a draft to marketing/launch-post.md; do not publish, post or contact anyone.

actions.label: Demo video script + storyboard
actions.prompt: Draft a 3-minute simulation script and shot list. Every blocked, fixed, published or reused outcome must use authoritative evidence or be visibly labelled simulation and unavailable as an observed result. Save a draft to marketing/demo-script.md; do not publish it.

actions.label: Launch social thread
actions.prompt: Draft a 6-post LinkedIn/X thread using only source-bound current evidence. Mark unavailable red-team, publication, adoption and customer outcomes explicitly unavailable; do not fabricate results or an invite to an unlaunched service. Save a draft to marketing/social-thread.md; do not post or publish it.

actions.label: Guild demo deck
actions.prompt: Draft an 8-slide guild demo deck using only authoritative current evidence. Use unavailable placeholders and labelled simulation where proof does not exist; never invent product results. Save the draft under marketing/ and do not present or distribute it.

actions.label: Messaging one-pager
actions.prompt: Draft the positioning and messaging one-pager from authoritative current evidence. State proof unavailable wherever a source-bound result is absent; never convert curated hypotheses into proof. Save a draft to marketing/one-pager.md and do not publish it.

actions.label: Recruit design partners
actions.prompt: Prepare a draft design-partner experiment and outreach message. Do not contact anyone or claim partners are recruited. Keep the three-guild target an unvalidated hypothesis and require separate human authorization before outreach.

actions.label: ROI calculator
actions.prompt: Build a draft ROI calculator with blank or explicitly user-supplied reuse, time-saved and loaded-cost inputs. Provide no default time or cost assumptions and make no ROI claim without source-bound measured inputs. Save it under marketing/; do not publish it.

actions.label: Objection-handling FAQ
actions.prompt: Draft the objection-handling FAQ using authoritative current evidence. Mark false-positive, cost, ownership and scanner-performance proof unavailable where no bound result exists; do not invent answers or publish the draft.

actions.label: Pricing / packaging ADR
actions.prompt: Only after the 84-skill internal release is approved, draft a separate external-scope ADR with unvalidated pricing hypotheses. Every proposal is not an offer and needs legal, security, willingness-to-pay and human decision evidence.

actions.label: Weekly metrics report
actions.prompt: Produce a read-only report for an exact UTC window and named environment/database identity with principal and ACL scope, cohort, denominator, deduplication and correction semantics. Publication comes only from the authoritative verified projection. Treat unavailable as unavailable; do not infer zero or fall back to fixtures, seeds or curated targets.

actions.label: Measure block rate / false positives
actions.prompt: Perform a read-only measurement only from an honest-submission cohort and authoritative corpus run bound to exact cohort and corpus hashes, current commit, UTC window, denominator and database identity. If either input is unavailable, record unmeasured and the instrumentation gap; never estimate from fixtures or curated data.

actions.label: Request isolated full-suite verification
actions.prompt: Run the full suite serially against the exact isolated *_test database. Bind the result to the current commit, source tree, and database identity; persist pass, fail, skip, xpass, and duration evidence. Never run concurrently or against the development catalog.

actions.label: Code review the whole build
actions.prompt: Review the codebase for bugs, security holes, and convention drift, and report findings ranked by severity.

actions.label: Validate a gap candidate
actions.prompt: Select one curated candidate for independent validation; do not infer priority from list order or severity prose. Validate it against authoritative source and runtime evidence before ranking or closing it, then write a failing test and the smallest correct fix.

actions.label: Propose refreshed dashboard data
actions.prompt: Re-derive proposed dashboard model changes from current source-bound references and prepare a reviewable patch only. Source paths and test definitions are references, never pass results, status proof or risk measurements. Do not update the integrity pin or activate changed templates; a separate reviewer or human must approve the exact model bytes and provenance.

actions.label: Investigate database availability
actions.prompt: Diagnose why the dashboard cannot observe the configured database. Perform read-only identity and health checks first; do not start containers, mutate schemas, or use a development database for test execution. Return evidence and a proposed recovery action.

actions.label: Review the highest-priority architecture decision
actions.prompt: Review the highest-priority active SemiSkill architecture decision against the current implementation and launch contract. Propose a qualifying or superseding ADR only when evidence requires it; preserve append-only decision history.

actions.label: Validate a verification-stage candidate
actions.prompt: Treat the stage register as curated and non-crediting. Select a candidate for independent validation, write a failing adversarial test, and implement the smallest hardening. A live or passing claim requires persisted, current-source-bound execution evidence; source presence alone earns no credit.

actions.label: Advance the next launch-planning item
actions.prompt: Select the highest-weight incomplete item in the curated launch-planning register and advance its evidence-backed work. Then verify the separate deterministic release_gate snapshot; this request confers no launch credit and must not mark any item complete without source-bound proof.

actions.label: Produce the next evidence-backed launch asset
actions.prompt: Select the next missing launch asset and produce a draft using only authoritative current product evidence. Keep unavailable metrics and outcomes explicitly unavailable; do not fabricate publication, red-team, adoption, pricing or customer proof, and do not publish, post or distribute the draft.

actions.label: Draft the next go-to-market experiment
actions.prompt: Select one proposed channel, state the unvalidated hypothesis, and draft the smallest experiment or asset. Do not contact anyone, internal or external, and do not launch, publish, post or send anything without separate human authorization; never claim measured impact without authoritative evidence.
